map_role: Three uneven dry industrial cable islands in an open-air suspension archipelago, with a real lower return flyway and selectively entered basal repair spaces
density_profile: Dense west/east suspended districts, sparse mid-span suspended tension net, intentionally open lower flyway and partially emptied repair pockets

route_grammar.primary: West upper launch to east horn checkpoint, descend via east transfer gap, west along free under-sling corridor to lower west finish
route_grammar.alternative: West upper launch to east worktown, skip east horn and descend through the transfer gap to westbound lower return; available after solid horn obstruction
route_grammar.rejoin: The two courses rejoin near the east lower reversal, then share the lower corridor

strong_motifs: Whole-width tension arch rooted at world edges
Dry excavation pockets beneath lower route
interesting_relationships: Upper traversable sky and lower corridor are divided by a structural suspension arch but joined by a literal eastern transfer throat
Industrial islands remain physically attached to boundary cables even where full-width lower racing corridor interrupts vertical legs
Upper ring of factories surrounds a deliberately unbuilt freight basin
authoring_affordances: Empty central cistern excavation can accept future falling-cell events
Bare west and east basal workshops permit human furnishing
Short southeast utility spur can grow into modular drydock machinery
Upper central freight cable can receive procedural part grammars without moving the actor-clear route

procedural_exemplar_value: Extract rooted cable-edge attachment plus nonuniform suspended inhabited islands, independent elevation corridors, side-exit switching, and intentional vacant maintenance bays as reusable spatial grammars
similarity_avoidance: Unlike Beaconfold's ground-rooted beacon skyline and long excavated express, this is a cable-supported cluster of work islands over an exposed dry basin, with an unexcavated open-air under-sling return. Unlike Aster's two stranded hulls, there are no vessels; unlike Rookfall's geological caldera, the central gap is mechanical and tension-supported.
